_about: Every game system the mod adds. layer 'data' = in the .mod (FCS records); 'plugin' = KenshiRealms.dll on RE_Kenshi.

rows.name: Kingdoms, clans and lords
rows.what: Factions, lord characters, war parties and seats from kingdoms/clans/lords sheets

rows.name: Recruitment
rows.what: Hireable troop templates in each recruitAt town, gated by rank

rows.name: Renown
rows.what: Earned for winning fights against a kingdom's enemies and capturing lords

rows.name: Nobody → Mercenary → Vassal
rows.what: Checks ladder.json thresholds; unlocks contract/oath dialogue

rows.name: Mercenary pay
rows.what: Daily contract wage plus bounty per enemy lord captured

rows.name: Influence
rows.what: Each clan (yours too) earns influence from battles and fiefs; it decays daily and is spent on votes

rows.name: Kingdom votes
rows.what: Every few days a kingdom may vote to declare war, make peace or grant an open fief; AI lords vote by honor/valor/greed, players spend influence

rows.name: Lord defection
rows.what: An unhappy, greedy lord whose clan is losing may change kingdom

rows.name: Fief income
rows.what: Pays fiefs.incomePerDay to the holder, minus garrison wages

rows.name: Save state
rows.what: Renown, influence, fief holders and contracts saved with the game
